title: Cosmic Fruit Offering
description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring a green-skinned woman with a colorful braided headdress emerging from a large pink bowl filled with yellow cereal, purple fruits, and orange slices. To the right, a white rectangular frame contains exploding blue planets and yellow stars against a dark cosmic background with red and black swirls.
prompt: Surreal painting of a green-skinned woman with elaborate colorful braids and headdress rising from a large pink bowl overflowing with yellow cereal, purple fruits, and sliced oranges. A white frame floats to the right containing exploding blue planets, stars, and bright yellow paint splashes. Dark cosmic background with red and black swirls, vibrant colors, detailed patterns, psychedelic elements.
